name: data-table
title: Data table
description: A native table that sorts and scrolls. A caption names it; columns marked data-sort sort by a real button with aria-sort, ascending then descending then the written order; money cells marked data-money are rewritten in the Indian grouping (125000 as ₹1,25,000, crore aware) on tabular figures; at phone width the table scrolls inside its own region and the page never scrolls sideways. Quiet is hairline rules and generous space; warm adds a hand-drawn header rule; playful adds colour and a tinted zebra.

budget.reason: Decision 0005: 12 KB of behaviour plus 8 KB for each of three skins; the pure core is budgeted apart (0010). Today 12,367 bytes: element 5.5 KB, pure core 4.0 KB (the Indian grouping, the sort state machine, the stable sort), skins quiet 0.1 KB, warm 2.1 KB (the seeded hand-drawn rule), playful 0.6 KB (it reuses warm's rule).

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
